output.summary: KEP-2079 proposes adding an endPort field to NetworkPolicyPort so a single ports entry can declare a contiguous port range instead of listing each port. The KEP is marked implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale:
Users must list every port individually in the ports array to allow a range (e.g., the NodePort range 32000-32768), and making an exception requires listing all other ports. Adding endPort to NetworkPolicyPort simplifies these rules. A design with a NetworkPolicyPortRange struct including an Except array was considered but dropped as adding too much complexity.</rationale>
